Adding my thoughts to this. I have been using one of these for the past few years.  https://shoplifeformchairs.ca/collections/high-back/products...  Although it's a Canadian based company, they have dealers across the US -  https://relaxtheback.com/apps/store-locator  Anything that is adjustable with a chair can be done with one of these. It's unfortunate that they are expensive and marked as "executive" chairs 
but the chairs are a couple of notches above Aerons and the SteelCases in comfort and adjustability.
